biggest_catch: Same-day cashout costs $1.25 per cashout — and Uber doesn't promise a fixed per-delivery amount; what you earn depends on the trip, promotions, and tips.
catches: Instant Pay costs $1.25 per cashout to a personal debit card (up to 6x/day); free only with the Uber Pro Card (automatic after every trip).
In most cases cash lands 'right away,' but some banks take a few business days (official FAQ).
New delivery people must complete their first trip to unlock Instant Pay.
Per-delivery pay is not fixed — it varies by trip with promotions and tips on top; the app shows what each trip pays before you accept.

c1.evidence: Uber Eats delivery is a real mechanism; official uber.com Instant Pay page: 'Most US drivers and delivery people can use Instant Pay once you complete your first trip. All you need is a debit card.'

c2.evidence: Official uber.com: 'Cash out with Instant Pay up to 6 times per day.' The Driver app shows trip earnings (fare + tips) before/after each delivery; amounts vary per trip (no fixed official range).

c3.evidence: No fee to sign up; $1.25 per cashout is per-payout, not upfront.

steps: Sign up as an Uber delivery person and pass the background check.
Complete your first delivery to unlock Instant Pay.
Add a debit card in the Driver app (most Visa/Mastercard/Discover).
Accept delivery requests; each trip's earnings (fare + tips) show in the app.
Cash out with Instant Pay up to 6 times per day ($1.25 each; free and automatic after every trip with the Uber Pro Card).
timing: Instant Pay: cash out up to 6x/day to your debit card ($1.25 each), cash usually right away. Uber Pro Card: free automatic payout after every trip.
who_pays: Uber pays you per delivery — base pay plus promotions plus 100% of tips; the app shows what each trip pays before you accept.
who_qualifies: 18+ (19+ in some markets); a background check; a vehicle or bike depending on the market; a debit card for Instant Pay.
work_available: Open once you're activated — you go online and take deliveries; order volume varies by market and time of day. You must complete your first trip to unlock Instant Pay.
what_gets_accepted: Each delivery pays what the app offered before you accepted — pay isn't rejected after the fact, but per-delivery amounts vary with promotions and tips.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: waiting between orders and the background check before your first trip. Your vehicle costs (fuel, maintenance, depreciation) come out of your earnings, and Instant Pay costs $1.25 per cashout (free with the Uber Pro Card).
when_cash_arrives: Instant Pay: cash out up to 6 times a day to your debit card ($1.25 each) — cash usually lands right away. Uber Pro Card holders get free automatic payout after every trip.

repeatable.cadence: Deliver whenever you want — each delivery earns, cash out daily with Fast Pay, and keep delivering.
